system.description:
Trained in the Dul Khagul shield-wall tradition, with ties to the Jotunas giant-kin allies.

  • Shield Wall: Ranged attacks against you and an adjacent ally have Disadvantage.
  • Dwarf-Friend: Advantage on dwarven clan etiquette and weapon identification checks. Trusted on sight by Dul Khagul dwarves.
